title: The Retry Tax: Why Static Same-Task Retries Can Cost More per Completion
abstract: arXiv:2611.29133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrying an agent after failure can complete more tasks while increasing the cost per completion. We study a static policy that stops at verified success or an attempt cap and otherwise resets the original prompt and workspace without passing feedback to the next request. Under stationary task success probabilities, independent attempts conditional on the task, and a common attempt cost, easier tasks tend to succeed earlier. When task success probabilities differ, the unresolved mix shifts toward harder tasks. Specializing classical survivor selection, we show that cost per completion is at least as high as in one-shot serving and that marginal cost per additional completion is nondecreasing wherever the completion increments are positive. These are different quantities: one averages spending over all completions, while the other prices the completions added by another attempt. translated_title: 重试税：为什么同一任务的静态重试可能导致每次完成成本更高
translated_abstract: 在失败后重试智能体可以完成更多任务，但同时会增加每次完成的成本。我们研究了一种静态策略：在验证成功或达到尝试次数上限时停止，否则重置原始提示和工作区，而不向前一个请求传递任何反馈。在任务成功率平稳、给定任务下各次尝试相互独立、且每次尝试成本相同的条件下，较容易的任务往往更早成功。当任务成功率存在差异时，未解决任务的组合会向更难的任务偏移。通过对经典的幸存者选择理论进行特化，我们证明了每次完成的成本至少不低于一次性服务的成本，并且在完成增量处处为正的情况下，每增加一次完成的边际成本是非递减的。这是两个不同的量：前者是分摊到所有完成上的平均支出，后者则是对额外一次尝试所新增完成进行的定价。随后，我们将每个任务现有的基准测试运行排列……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“重试税”概念，通过特化经典幸存者选择理论证明：对智能体失败后进行不传递反馈的静态同任务重试，虽然能增加完成数量，但每次完成的平均成本不低于一次性服务，且额外完成的边际成本递增，其根本原因在于重试后未解决任务池会偏向更难的任务。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "retry tax" concept, proving via a specialization of classical survivor selection that static same-task retries without feedback transfer raise per-completion cost above one-shot serving, with nondecreasing marginal cost per additional completion, because the unresolved task mix shifts toward harder tasks.
